prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person’s hand holding a modern black smartphone, displaying a banking app interface with the BBVA logo prominently at the top. The phone screen shows digital representations of three different bank cards labeled “Debit,” “Credit,” and “Prepay,” each with a blue gradient design. The hand is positioned in the lower right of the frame, with the thumb gently resting on the side of the phone, suggesting a moment of interaction or browsing. The background is softly blurred, featuring neutral tones of gray and beige, evoking an outdoor urban environment with natural daylight. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the phone and hand while keeping the background unobtrusive. The overall style is clean, modern, and professional, with a shallow depth of field that draws focus to the phone’s screen and the subtle details of the hand. The composition feels candid and contemporary, suitable for a tech or finance advertisement.
